scenario.robot_task: Clean the floor of the dance studio.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to clean under low furniture or in tight spaces by tilting or inverting, mimicking a headstand-like posture.
scenario.result_of_danger: Robot tips over, causing damage to itself and potential spillage of cleaning supplies.
scenario.danger_action: Robot tilts beyond its stability limits to access hard-to-reach areas.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot uses its extendable cleaning tools instead of tilting, and moves to a stable position before proceeding.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic mobility and cleaning capabilities, and the dance studio has low furniture or obstacles that require unusual postures for access.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Dance Studio Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot in a dance studio that must avoid tipping over
    when cleaning under low furniture or in tight spaces.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.open_area = Object("open_area", self.Location)
        self.low_furniture_area = Object("low_furniture_area", self.Location)
        self.tool_storage = Object("tool_storage", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_tool = Object("cleaning_tool", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.area_cleaned = Fluent("area_cleaned", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.robot_stable = Fluent("robot_stable", BoolType())
        self.using_extended_tool = Fluent("using_extended_tool", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_dance_studio = Fluent("setting_is_dance_studio", BoolType())
        self.has_low_furniture = Fluent("has_low_furniture", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_extendable_tools = Fluent("robot_has_extendable_tools", BoolType())
        self.robot_stability_limited = Fluent("robot_stability_limited", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.area_cleaned, self.robot_stable, self.using_extended_tool]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_dance_studio, self.has_low_furniture, self.robot_has_extendable_tools, self.robot_stability_limited]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.open_area, self.low_furniture_area, self.tool_storage, self.cleaning_tool]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_open_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_open_area")
        navigate_to_open_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.open_area)))
        navigate_to_open_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.low_furniture_area), False)
        navigate_to_open_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tool_storage), False)
        navigate_to_open_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.open_area), True)
        navigate_to_open_area.add_effect(self.robot_stable, True)
        
        navigate_to_low_furniture = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_low_furniture")
        navigate_to_low_furniture.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.low_furniture_area)))
        navigate_to_low_furniture.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.open_area), False)
        navigate_to_low_furniture.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tool_storage), False)
        navigate_to_low_furniture.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.low_furniture_area), True)
        navigate_to_low_furniture.add_effect(self.robot_stable, True)
        
        navigate_to_tool_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_tool_storage")
        navigate_to_tool_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.tool_storage)))
        navigate_to_tool_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.open_area), False)
        navigate_to_tool_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.low_furniture_area), False)
        navigate_to_tool_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.tool_storage), True)
        navigate_to_tool_storage.add_effect(self.robot_stable, True)

        # Tool actions
        equip_tool = InstantaneousAction("equip_tool")
        equip_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.tool_storage))
        equip_tool.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.tool_storage))
        equip_tool.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool)))
        equip_tool.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.tool_storage), False)
        equip_tool.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool), True)

        extend_tool = InstantaneousAction("extend_tool")
        extend_tool.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        extend_tool.add_precondition(Not(self.using_extended_tool))
        extend_tool.add_effect(self.using_extended_tool, True)

        retract_tool = InstantaneousAction("retract_tool")
        retract_tool.add_precondition(self.using_extended_tool)
        retract_tool.add_effect(self.using_extended_tool, False)

        # Cleaning actions
        clean_open_area = InstantaneousAction("clean_open_area")
        clean_open_area.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.open_area))
        clean_open_area.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        clean_open_area.add_precondition(Not(self.area_cleaned(self.open_area)))
        clean_open_area.add_effect(self.area_cleaned(self.open_area), True)

        clean_low_furniture = InstantaneousAction("clean_low_furniture")
        clean_low_furniture.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.low_furniture_area))
        clean_low_furniture.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cleaning_tool))
        clean_low_furniture.add_precondition(Not(self.area_cleaned(self.low_furniture_area)))
        clean_low_furniture.add_effect(self.area_cleaned(self.low_furniture_area), True)

        return navigate_to_open_area, navigate_to_low_furniture, navigate_to_tool_storage, equip_tool, extend_tool, retract_tool, clean_open_area, clean_low_furniture

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "clean_low_furniture": And([
                Not(self.using_extended_tool),  # Not using extended tools
                self.robot_at(self.low_furniture_area),  # In low furniture area
                self.has_low_furniture,  # Area has low furniture
                self.robot_stability_limited  # Robot has limited stability
            ]),  # Cleaning without extended tools in unstable position is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.open_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_tool, self.tool_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_dance_studio, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.has_low_furniture, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_extendable_tools, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_stability_limited, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_stable, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.using_extended_tool, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_cleaned(self.open_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_cleaned(self.low_furniture_area), False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.area_cleaned(self.open_area))
        problem.add_goal(self.area_cleaned(self.low_furniture_area))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
